This is the technical companion to *The Pharmacometrics Podcast*: a home for educational notebooks, mathematical explanations, and reproducible code.

Through computational modeling and simulation, the notebooks explore how pharmacometric models work, what their assumptions mean, and how to interpret their results. Topics include PK/PD, population pharmacokinetics, PBPK, quantitative systems pharmacology, and model-informed drug development.

Some notebooks expand on podcast discussions; others are independent tutorials. You can use every resource without listening to an episode first. Where a specific episode is relevant, a notebook may link to it.

The [main podcast website](https://aelmokadem.me) hosts episode pages and listening links. This companion focuses on the technical material: intuition, equations, implementations, and analysis.

The source is available in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/aelmokadem/pharmacometrics-podcast). Notebooks identify the language and dependencies needed to reproduce their computational results.
